verses.geez: ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ በአድልዎ፡ ይገብርዋ፡ ለኀጢአት፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ይትባዛኅ፡ ይመይጥ፡ ዐይኖ።
verses.translation: Many have sinned for a small matter; and he that seeketh for abundance will turn his eyes away.

translations.lxx: Many have sinned for a small matter; and he that seeketh for abundance will turn his eyes away.
translations.ron: Din pricina banilor, mulţi au păcătuit şi cine caută să se îmbogăţească îşi întoarce ochiul de la dreptate.
translations.grk: Χαρὶν ἀδιαφόρου πολλοὶ ἥμαρτον, καὶ ὁ ζητῶν πληθύναι ἀποστρέψει ὀφθαλμόν.

verses.geez: ማእከለ፡ ንድቀ፡ አእባን፡ ይተክሉ፡ መትከለ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ሤጥ፡ ወተግባር፡ ትመጽእ፡ ኀጢአት።
verses.translation: As a nail sticketh fast between the joinings of the stones; so doth sin stick close between buying and selling.

translations.lxx: As a nail sticketh fast between the joinings of the stones; so doth sin stick close between buying and selling.
translations.ron: Între încheieturile pietrelor se înfige ţăruşul şi între vânzare şi cumpărare se va strânge păcatul.
translations.grk: Ἀναμέσον ἁρμῶν λίθων παγήσεται πάσσαλος, καὶ ἀναμέσον πράσεως καὶ ἀγορασμοῦ συντριβήσεται ἁμαρτία.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ኢያፍጠነ፡ ተዐቅቦ፡ በፍርሀተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኢይጐነዲ፡ ተገፍትኦ፡ ቤቱ።
verses.translation: Unless a man hold himself diligently in the fear of the Lord, his house shall soon be overthrown.

translations.lxx: Unless a man hold himself diligently in the fear of the Lord, his house shall soon be overthrown.
translations.ron: De nu se va ţine cineva pe sine cu sârguinţă în frica Domnului, curând se va nărui casa lui.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν μὴ ἐν φόβῳ Κυρίου κρατήσῃ κατὰ σπουδὴν, ἐν τάχει καταστραφήσεται αὐτοῦ ὁ οἶκος.

verses.geez: ውስተ፡ መንጠፍት፡ ይጥሕል፡ ሐሠረ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሰብእኒ፡ እምኅሊናሁ፡ ተረክበ፡ ርስሐቱ።
verses.translation: As when one sifteth with a sieve, the refuse remaineth; so the filth of man in his talk.

translations.lxx: As when one sifteth with a sieve, the refuse remaineth; so the filth of man in his talk.
translations.ron: Când se clatină ciurul, rămân gunoaiele; tot aşa şi pleava omului în vorbele lui.
translations.grk: Ἐν σείσματι κοσκίνου διαμένει κοπρία, οὕτως σκύβαλα ἀνθρώπου ἐν λογισμῷ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ለንዋየ፡ ለብሓኒ፡ እሳት፡ ይፈትኖ፡ ወለሰብእኒ፡ ኅሊና፡ ልቡ፡ ያሜክሮ።
verses.translation: The furnace proveth the potter's vessels; so the trial of man is in his reasoning.

translations.lxx: The furnace proveth the potter's vessels; so the trial of man is in his reasoning.
translations.ron: Vasele olarului le lămureşte cuptorul; iar ispita omului cugetul lui.
translations.grk: Σκεύη κεραμέως δοκιμάζει κάμινος, καὶ πειρασμὸς ἀνθρώπου ἐν διαλογισμῷ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዐቃቢሁ፡ ለቀምሕ፡ ይሬኢ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ከማሁ፡ ቃሉ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ይከሥቶ፡ ፍትወተ፡ ልቡ።
verses.translation: The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.

translations.lxx: The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.
translations.ron: Cum a fost lucrat pomul, arată rodul lui; aşa şi cuvântul arată gândul cel din inima omului.
translations.grk: Γεώργιον ξύλου ἐκφαίνει ὁ καρπὸς αὐτοῦ, οὕτως λόγος ἐνθυμήματος καρδίας ἀνθρώπου.

verses.geez: እንበለ፡ ትጠይቆ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ኢትንአዶ፡ እስመ፡ ግዕዙ፡ ያሜክርዎ፡ ለሰብእ።
verses.translation: Praise no man before thou hearest him speak; for this is the trial of men.

translations.lxx: Praise no man before thou hearest him speak; for this is the trial of men.
translations.ron: Să nu lauzi pe nimeni înainte de a vorbi cu el, căci cuvântul este piatra de încercare u omului.
translations.grk: Πρὸ λογισμοῦ μὴ ἐπαινέσῃς ἄνδρα, οὗτος γὰρ πειρασμὸς ἀνθρώπων.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ ዴገንካ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ትረክባ፡ ወትለብሳ፡ ከመ፡ ልብሰ፡ ጶዴር፡ ዘክቡር።
verses.translation: If thou followest righteousness, thou shalt obtain her, and put her on, as a glorious long robe.

translations.lxx: If thou followest righteousness, thou shalt obtain her, and put her on, as a glorious long robe.
translations.ron: De vei alerga după dreptate, o vei prinde şi te vei îmbrăca cu ea ca şi cu o haină lungă de mărire.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν διώκῃς τὸ δίκαιον, καταλήψῃ, καὶ ἐνδύσῃ αὐτὸ ὡς ποδήρη δόξης.

verses.geez: አዕዋፍኒ፡ ምስለ፡ ዘመዱ፡ የኀድር፡ ወጽድቅኒ፡ ኀበ፡ እለ፡ ይገብርዋ፡ ተሐውር።
verses.translation: The birds will resort unto their like; so will truth return unto them that practise in her.

translations.lxx: The birds will resort unto their like; so will truth return unto them that practise in her.
translations.ron: Păsările la cele ce sunt asemenea lor poposesc şi adevărul la cei care îl fac se întoarce.
translations.grk: Πετεινὰ πρὸς τὰ ὅμοια αὐτοῖς καταλύσει, καὶ ἀλήθεια πρὸς τοὺς ἐργαζομένους αὐτὴν ἐπανήξει.

verses.geez: ዐንበሳ፡ ይንዑ፡ ዘይበልዕ፡ ከማሁ፡ ኀጢአትኒ፡ ትንዕዎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ይገብርዋ።
verses.translation: As the lion lieth in wait for the prey; so sin for them that work iniquity.

translations.lxx: As the lion lieth in wait for the prey; so sin for them that work iniquity.
translations.ron: Leul pândeşte vânatul; aşa şi păcatele pe cei care fac nedreptăţi.
translations.grk: Λέων θήραν ἐνεδρεύει, οὕτως ἁμαρτίαι ἐργαζομένους ἄδικα.

verses.geez: ጻድቅሰ፡ ይሜህር፡ ዘልፈ፡ ጥበበ፡ ወአብድሰ፡ ባሕቱ፡ እንተ፡ ጸብሐት፡ የሐጽጽ፡ ልቡ፡ ከመ፡ ወርኅ።
verses.translation: The discourse of a godly man is always with wisdom; but a fool changeth as the moon.

translations.lxx: The discourse of a godly man is always with wisdom; but a fool changeth as the moon.
translations.ron: Vorba celui cuvios este totdeauna cu înţelepciune; iar cel nebun se schimbă ca luna.
translations.grk: Διήγησις εὐσεβοῦς διαπαντὸς σοφία, ὁ δὲ ἄφρων ὡς σελήνη ἀλλοιοῦται.

verses.geez: በኀበ፡ አብዳን፡ ተዐቀብ፡ ጊዜሁ፡ ወበኀበ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ተጠየቅ፡ በኵሉ፡ ጊዜ።
verses.translation: If thou be among the indiscreet, observe the time; but be continually among men of understanding.

translations.lxx: If thou be among the indiscreet, observe the time; but be continually among men of understanding.
translations.ron: Când te afli în mijlocul proştilor, cruţă-ţi vremea; iar cu cei înţelepţi zăboveşte fără teamă.
translations.grk: Εἰς μέσον ἀσυνέτων συντήρησον καιρὸν, εἰς μέσον δὲ διανοουμένων ἐνδελέχιζε.

verses.geez: ነገሮሙ፡ ለአብዳን፡ ያስተቋጥዕ፡ ወሠሐቆሙኒ፡ ፍግዐ፡ ኀጢአት።
verses.translation: The discourse of fools is irksome, and their sport is the wantonness of sin.

translations.lxx: The discourse of fools is irksome, and their sport is the wantonness of sin.
translations.ron: Vorbirea proştilor este o groază şi râsul lor izbucneşte în desfătările păcatului.
translations.grk: Διήγησις μωρῶν προσόχθισμα, καὶ ὁ γέλως αὐτῶν ἐν σπατάλῃ ἁμαρτίας.

verses.geez: ነገሩ፡ ለዘ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ይምሕል፡ ያንሦጥጥ፡ ሥዕርተ፡ ወላኳሆሙኒ፡ ያጸምም፡ እዝነ።
verses.translation: The talk of him that sweareth much maketh the hair stand upright; and their brawls make one stop his ears.

translations.lxx: The talk of him that sweareth much maketh the hair stand upright; and their brawls make one stop his ears.
translations.ron: Vorba celui care mult se jură zbârleşte părul şi când se ceartă îţi asurzeşte urechile.
translations.grk: Λαλιὰ πολυόρκου ὀρθώσει τρίχας, καὶ ἡ μάχη αὐτῶν ἐμφραγμὸς ὠτίων.

verses.geez: ያክዑ፡ ደመ፡ ላኳሆሙ፡ ለዕቡያን፡ ወጋእዞሙ፡ ስራሕ፡ ለዘይሰምዖሙ።
verses.translation: The strife of the proud is bloodshedding, and their revilings are grievous to the ear.

translations.lxx: The strife of the proud is bloodshedding, and their revilings are grievous to the ear.
translations.ron: Vărsare de sânge vine din vrajba trufaşilor şi sudalma lor este grea la auz.
translations.grk: Ἔκχυσις αἵματος μάχη ὑπερηφάνων, καὶ ἡ διαλοιδόρησις αὐτῶν ἀκοὴ μοχθηρά.

verses.geez: ዘከሠተ፡ ምክረ፡ ቢጹ፡ ሀጕለ፡ ሃይማኖቶሙ፡ ወኢይረክብ፡ እንከ፡ ዐርከ፡ ዘከመ፡ ልቡ።
verses.translation: Whoso discovereth secrets loseth his credit; and shall never find friend to his mind.

translations.lxx: Whoso discovereth secrets loseth his credit; and shall never find friend to his mind.
translations.ron: Cel care descoperă tainele a pierdut credinţa şi nu va afla prieten după inima sa.
translations.grk: Ὁ ἀποκαλύπτων μυστήρια ἀπώλεσε πίστιν, καὶ οὐ μὴ εὕρῃ φίλον πρὸς τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ዕቀብ፡ ዐርከከ፡ ወተአመን፡ ምስሌሁ፡ ወለእመሰ፡ ከሠትከ፡ ምክሮ፡ ኢትዴግኖ፡(እንከ፡ወኢትትልዎ፡)ድኅሬሁ።
verses.translation: Love thy friend, and be faithful unto him: but if thou betrayest his secrets, follow no more after him.

translations.lxx: Love thy friend, and be faithful unto him: but if thou betrayest his secrets, follow no more after him.
translations.ron: Iubeşte pe prieten şi fii credincios cu el; iar de vei descoperi tainele lui, nu vei mai fi prieten cu el.
translations.grk: Στέρξον φίλον, καὶ πιστώθητι μετʼ αὐτοῦ· ἐὰν δὲ ἀποκαλύψῃς τὰ μυστήρια αὐτοῦ, οὐ μὴ καταδιώξῃς ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ሀጕለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጸላኢሁ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሀጐልካሁ፡ አንተኒ፡ ታእኃሁ፡ ለዐርክከ።
verses.translation: For as a man hath destroyed his enemy; so hast thou lost the love of thy neighbour.

translations.lxx: For as a man hath destroyed his enemy; so hast thou lost the love of thy neighbour.
translations.ron: Căci precum un om şi-a pierdut moştenirea, aşa şi tu ai pierdut prietenia aproapelui tău.
translations.grk: Καθὼς γὰρ ἀπώλεσεν ἄνθρωπος τὸν ἐχθρὸν αὐτοῦ, οὕτως ἀπώλεσας τὴν φιλίαν τοῦ πλησίου·

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ዖፍ፡ እንተ፡ ታመሥጠከ፡ እምእዴከ፡ ከማሁ፡ ሰረረ፡ እምኔከ፡ ዐርክከ።
verses.translation: As one that letteth a bird go out of his hand, so hast thou let thy neighbour go, and shalt not get him again.

translations.lxx: As one that letteth a bird go out of his hand, so hast thou let thy neighbour go, and shalt not get him again.
translations.ron: Şi ca şi cum ai fi slobozit o pasăre din mâna ta, aşa ai scăpat pe prietenul tău şi nu-l vei mai câştiga pe el.
translations.grk: καὶ ὡς πετεινὸν ἐκ χειρός σου ἀπελύσας, οὕτως ἀφῆκας τὸν πλησίον, καὶ οὐ θηρεύσεις αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ወኢትዴግኖ፡ እንከ፡ እስመ፡ ነዋኅ፡ ኀበ፡ አምሠጠከ፡ ከመ፡ አምሠጠት፡ ምዳቊ፡ እምነ፡ ማዕገት።
verses.translation: Follow after him no more, for he is too far off; he is as a roe escaped out of the snare.

translations.lxx: Follow after him no more, for he is too far off; he is as a roe escaped out of the snare.
translations.ron: Nu alerga după el, că mult s-a depărtat şi a fugit ca o căprioară din laţ.
translations.grk: Μὴ αὐτὸν διώξῃς, ὅτι μακρὰν ἀπέστῃ, καὶ ἐξέφυγεν ὡς δορκὰς ἐκ παγίδος.

verses.geez: ሶበሰ፡ ቊስል፡ ውእቱ፡ እምፈወስዎ፡ ወለዘኒ፡ ተጽዕለ፡ ያስተማውጽዎ፡ ወለዘሰ፡ ከሠተ፡ ምክረተ፡ ቢጹ፡ ይቀብጽዎ።
verses.translation: As for a wound, it may be bound up; and after reviling there may be reconcilement: but he that betrayeth secrets is without hope.

translations.lxx: As for a wound, it may be bound up; and after reviling there may be reconcilement: but he that betrayeth secrets is without hope.
translations.ron: Că rana se poate lega şi pentru vrajbă este pace; iar cel care a descoperit tainele a pierdut încrederea.
translations.grk: Ὅτι θραῦσμά ἐστι καταδῆσαι, καὶ λοιδορίας ἐστὶ διαλλαγή· ὁ δὲ ἀποκαλύψας μυστήρια ἀπήλπισε.

verses.geez: ዘይቀጽብ፡ በዐይኑ፡ ኢይሤኒ፡ ኅሊናሁ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይክል፡ አኅደጎተ፡ እከዩ።
verses.translation: He that winketh with the eyes worketh evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him.

translations.lxx: He that winketh with the eyes worketh evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him.
translations.ron: Cel care face cu ochiul meşteşugeşte rele şi cel înţelept se va depărta de el.
translations.grk: Διανεύων ὀφθαλμῷ τεκταίνει κακὰ, καὶ οὐδεὶς αὑτὸν ἀποστήσει ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ለዐይንከሰ፡ ያጥዕም፡ ለከ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ዘነበብከ፡ ይንእደከ፡ ወድኅረ፡ የዐልወከ፡ ቃሎ፡ ወያስሕተከ፡ በቃልከ፡ እንተ፡ ነበብከ።
verses.translation: When thou art present, he will speak sweetly, and will admire thy words: but at the last he will writhe his mouth, and slander thy sayings.

translations.lxx: When thou art present, he will speak sweetly, and will admire thy words: but at the last he will writhe his mouth, and slander thy sayings.
translations.ron: Înaintea ochilor tăi, îndulci-va gura sa şi de cuvintele tale se va mira, lăudându-te;
translations.grk: Ἀπέναντι τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν σου γλυκανεῖ στόμα σου, καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν λόγων σου ἐκθαυμάσει, ὕστερον δὲ διαστρέψει τὸ στόμα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τοῖς λόγοις σου δώσει σκάνδαλον.

verses.geez: ብዙኃን፡ እለ፡ ጸላእኩ፡ ወአኮሰ፡ ከማሁ፡ ወእግዚአብሔርኒ፡ ጸልአ፡ ኪያሁ።
verses.translation: I have hated many things, but nothing like him; for the Lord will hate him.

translations.lxx: I have hated many things, but nothing like him; for the Lord will hate him.
translations.ron: Iar în spate îşi va schimba vorbirea şi îţi va pune în seamă cuvinte care rănesc.
translations.grk: Πολλὰ ἐμίσησα καὶ οὐχ ὡμοίωσα αὐτῷ, καὶ ὁ Κύριος μισήσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: ዘይወግር፡ እብነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ትወርድ፡ ዲበ፡ ርእሱ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ ዐመፃሰ፡ ይትዐወቅ፡ ቊስሉ።
verses.translation: Whoso casteth a stone on high casteth it on his own head; and a deceitful stroke shall make wounds.

translations.lxx: Whoso casteth a stone on high casteth it on his own head; and a deceitful stroke shall make wounds.
translations.ron: Multe am urât, dar pe acesta mai mult decât orice; şi Domnul îl va urî de asemenea.
translations.grk: Ὁ βάλλων λίθον εἰς ὕψος ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ βάλλει, καὶ πληγὴ δολία διελεῖ τραύματα.

verses.geez: ዘከረየ፡ ግበ፡(ለቢጹ፡)ለሊሁ፡ ይወድቅ፡ ውስቴቱ፡ ወዘኒ፡ ወርዐ፡ መሥገርተ፡ ውእቱ፡ ይሠግር፡ ቦቱ።
verses.translation: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that setteth a trap shall be taken therein.

translations.lxx: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that setteth a trap shall be taken therein.
translations.ron: Cel care aruncă piatră în sus, peste capul său o aruncă şi lovitura vicleană dă naştere la răni.
translations.grk: Ὁ ὀρύσσων βόθρον εἰς αὐτὸν ἐμπεσεῖται, καὶ ὁ ἱστῶν παγίδα ἐν αὐτῇ ἁλώσεται.

verses.geez: ኀጢአት፡ ጸዐሎሙ፡ ወሠሐቆሙ፡ ለዕቡያን፡ ከመ፡ ዐንበሳ፡ ትንፅዎሙ፡ ወትትቤቀሎሙ።
verses.translation: Mockery and reproach are from the proud; but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for him.

translations.lxx: Mockery and reproach are from the proud; but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for him.
translations.ron: Cel care face rele, peste el vor cădea şi nu va cunoaşte de unde-i vin.
translations.grk: Ἐμπαιγμὸς καὶ ὀνειδισμὸς ὑπερηφάνων, καὶ ἡ ἐκδίκησις ὡς λέων ἐνεδρεύσει αὐτόν.

verses.geez: በመሥገርት፡ ይሠግሩ፡ እለ፡ ይትፌሥሑ፡ በድቀቱ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ መቅሠፍት፡ ይመስዎሙ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይብጽሖሙ፡ ጊዜ፡ ሞቶሙ።
verses.translation: They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare; and anguish shall consume them before they die.

translations.lxx: They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare; and anguish shall consume them before they die.
translations.ron: Batjocura, sudalma este partea celor trufaşi şi pedeapsa ca leul va pândi asupra lor.
translations.grk: Παγίδι ἁλώσονται οἱ εὐφραινόμενοι πτώσει εὐσεβῶν, καὶ ὀδύνη καταναλώσει αὐτοὺς πρὸ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτῶν.

verses.geez: መዐትኒ፡ ወቊጥዓ፡ ርኵሳን፡ እሙንቱ፡ ወበኀበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ይሄልዉ።
verses.translation: Malice and wrath, even these are abominations; and the sinful man shall have them both.

translations.lxx: Malice and wrath, even these are abominations; and the sinful man shall have them both.
translations.ron: În laţ se vor prinde cei care se bucură de căderea celor drepţi şi durerea îi va mistui mai înainte de a muri.
translations.grk: Μῆνις καὶ ὀργὴ, καὶ ταῦτά ἐστι βδελύγματα, καὶ ἀνὴρ ἁμαρτωλὸς ἐγκρατὴς ἔσται αὐτῶν.
